# thousandeyes_tests_dns_trace (Resource)

Get DNS Trace test.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Code generated by tfpfgen. DO NOT EDIT.

resource "thousandeyes_tests_dns_trace" "example" {
  domain   = "example.com"
  interval = 3600
  agents   = [{ agent_id = "3" }]
}
```
